title: Custody and investment of Zilla Panchayat Fund

versions.Latest:
167. Custody and investment of Zilla Panchayat Fund.—

—   (1) The amounts at the 
credit of the Zilla Panchayat Fund shall be kept in the Government Treasury. 
(2) It shall be lawful for the Zilla Panchayat to deposit with the sanction of the 
Government, in any Scheduled Bank or Co-operative Bank in the State, any surplus funds 
in its hands which may not be required for current charges and with like sanction, to 
invest such funds in securities of the Government of India or the State Government or in 
such other securities as   the Government may, from time to time, approve in this behalf 
and to vary such investment or dispose of such securities with like sanction.
